buyer.notes: Founded 2012, HQ Hoboken NJ. Stated focus (company boilerplate repeated in its press releases and trade coverage): small-bay warehouses 20,000-100,000 SF, suite sizes 20,000-40,000 SF, value-add, deals averaging under $10M that institutional capital overlooks, markets with strong demographics and high barriers incl. Northern New Jersey. Separate Industrial Sale-Leaseback Fund targets infill industrial 20,000-200,000 SF with ~10-year average lease term ($150M credit line, ROI-NJ 2024-10-21 https://www.roi-nj.com/2024/10/21/real_estate/faropoint-secures-150m-line-with-for-industrial-sale-leaseback-fund/). Press releases direct acquisition inquiries to Vadim Greenberg, Head of Acquisitions. NJ deals seen: Oakland / 153 Bauer Dr 44,300 SF (2022-07, $9,600,000; NJBIZ); Meadowlands / 2 last-mile buildings (2023-04, $28,300,000; ROI-NJ https://www.roi-nj.com/2023/04/25/real_estate_development/faropoint-acquires-2-last-mile-industrial-buildings-in-meadowlands-for-28-3m/); Allendale (7 buildings, 370,064 SF) + Mahwah (3 buildings, 399,999 SF) Bergen County portfolio, 770,000+ SF, from the Camber Real Estate Partners / Advance Realty Investors JV (date n/a, $144,500,000; RE-NJ https://re-nj.com/camber-advance-sell-770000-sq-ft-bergen-county-industrial-portfolio-in-deal-with-faropoint/; NJBIZ https://njbiz.com/faropoint-pays-144m-for-north-jersey-industrial-portfolio/); Rockaway / Morris County shallow-bay additions (NJBIZ https://njbiz.com/faropoint-rockaway-morris-county-shallow-bay-industrial/); Morris County / 30,000 SF light industrial (RE-NJ); Kushner 10-building Bergen/Morris portfolio (2021-12, $132,500,000; per A7 row). Also announced a 195,421 SF Class A NJ development (2024-12). 2025 $328M five-state portfolio excluded (2025 deals handled locally).
